bullets: Hackathon is ~5-6 weeks away; the engineering atrium needs a booking form for about 150 people.
Format decided: a 12-hour event, Saturday 10 a.m. to 10 p.m.
Sponsorship one-pager, alumni judges and the registration page all still need owners or dates.
The $800 student-council budget is unconfirmed; last year's food ran out.
No backup venue if the atrium is not confirmed in time.
summary.paragraph: The club planned its spring hackathon. Chloe will submit the venue booking form, Diego will draft a sponsorship one-pager, Mei will confirm the food budget with the treasurer and later refresh the registration page, and Ben will start reaching out to alumni judges through the career center. The group chose a twelve-hour format. Food budgeting and a backup venue remain unresolved.

decisions.decision: Run the hackathon as a 12-hour event, Saturday 10 a.m. to 10 p.m.
decisions.rationale: Easier for volunteers; participants can still sleep.
decisions.evidence_quote: we're going with twelve hours, Saturday ten a.m. to ten p.m.

decisions.decision: Mei owns the registration page update, after midterms.
decisions.evidence_quote: let's say it's Mei's, we'll look at it after midterms

action_items.title: Submit atrium booking form (150 headcount)
action_items.description: The venue takes about a week to process the booking.
action_items.evidence_quote: Chloe, submit the form by next Wednesday, please

action_items.title: Put together a sponsorship one-pager
action_items.description: Rough version for the club to review; consider the campus bookstore as another sponsor.
action_items.evidence_quote: Diego, can you put together a sponsorship deck?

action_items.title: Email the treasurer to confirm the $800 food budget
action_items.description: Nobody was sure the student-council money is confirmed.
action_items.evidence_quote: I'll email the treasurer to confirm the budget, tomorrow

action_items.title: Reach out to the alumni network for judges
action_items.description: Start with the career center; Ben was unsure who to contact.
action_items.evidence_quote: Ben, can you reach out to the alumni network?

action_items.title: Update the registration page
action_items.description: The page is still last year's version.
action_items.evidence_quote: let's say it's Mei's, we'll look at it after midterms

action_items.title: Plan a larger food budget
action_items.description: Pizza ran out at 10 p.m. last year.
action_items.evidence_quote: We should budget more food this time.

open_questions.question: Is the $800 student-council budget actually confirmed?
Who is the right contact in the alumni network?
Should the campus bookstore be approached as a sponsor?

risks.risk: No backup venue if the atrium is not confirmed in time.
Food could run out again, as it did last year.
Registration page may be out of date close to the event; Mei is busy with midterms.
